errors.text_span: Cardio is tan, Gastro is light orange, Infect is light pink, Neuro is light gray, Obstetrics is pale yellow, and Pediatrics is light brown
errors.evidence: The colors in the description do not match the figure. Cardio is light orange, Gastro is orange, Infect is darker orange, Neuro is light brown, Obstetrics is medium brown, and Pediatrics is dark brown. No tan, light pink, light gray, or pale yellow bars exist.

errors.text_span: The shortest bar, representing Gastro, has an approximate value of -26.6, while the tallest bar, representing Pediatrics, has an approximate value of -22.2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the shortest and tallest bars. The tallest bars are consistently the light blue MistralV0.2-Base bars, not Pediatrics. Gastro bars are not the shortest overall; Infect bars are generally shorter.

errors.text_span: Neuro exhibiting the lowest values around -25.1
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states Neuro has the lowest values. The light blue MistralV0.2-Base bars are the tallest (highest values), and Infect bars are generally the shortest (lowest values). Neuro bars are not the lowest.

errors.text_span: Each medical specialty is represented by a bar
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that each medical specialty is represented by a single bar. Each specialty group contains multiple bars, including one for MistralV0.2-Base and one for each fine-tuned specialty.
The description omits the presence of the light blue bars representing MistralV0.2-Base in each group, which are critical to the figure.
The description does not mention that the light blue bar (MistralV0.2-Base) is always the tallest in each group.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars start from -22 and descend towards -27.

errors.text_span: The bars generally descend in value from left to right
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims a general descending trend from left to right, which is not supported by the figure. The bars do not follow a consistent left-to-right trend.
